text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
H-How was that, Trainer!? I think my body 
was moving pretty well, though!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Was that... not the case?
choice_data_list: That was such a great run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wah, thank you so much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Now I can finally bring good news back to 
the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I can at least tell Grandmother, who has 
high hopes for me in the Classics, 'I've 
made my debut!'"

...It's still quite far from what's 
expected. Even so, this might just be a 
significant step forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you too, Ines. Because you were 
watching over me, I...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... Don't go making Friend A worry 
so much, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: See ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ines, where are you going...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta get ready for my Make a Debut 
too. Just like Ryan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Even a roommate who isn't from the 
prestigious Mejiro family has her own 
modest life to live. Period♪"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Then we'll finish this talk tonight! Once 
we're back in the room, Ryan-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines... left... Now it's just the two of 
us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It feels kinda lonely... But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You'll stay by my side forever, right, 
Trainer? As besties for life!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! Um, I know I still have a 
lot to learn, but please take good care of 
me for years to come...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
……Wait, huh? That greeting just now 
sounded kind of……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I may be inexperienced, but please take 
care of me forever"... Awawawa... Isn't 
this practically like a newlywed couple!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Pleease forget what just happened!! Moving 
on!! I'll do my best next time too~!!

Mejiro Ryan completed her debut race 
safely. However, the real test of her true 
worth will be what comes next.

We set our sights on the Junior Cup. We'll 
make our presence known on the Classic 
circuit starting from the open-class race 
in the new year.
